'''2011 Bespin Regionals Jim Li LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
